label: Consumers who have used AI in some travel context
question: How many people have used AI for travel?
answer: 67% of consumers have used AI in some travel context, from a Booking.com survey of 37,325 people across 33 markets.
methodology: Online survey of 37,325 respondents across 33 markets, fielded April–May 2025 for the Global AI Sentiment Report. Among those who had used AI in travel, 98% used it for planning or booking and 96% used it while travelling.
